# src/lab

Executable ordinary-Incan contract probes used to test Pallay's architecture before vocabulary or production integrations are selected.

This directory may contain deterministic application, authority, query, storage, or runtime stand-ins. Those stand-ins are test fixtures, not Pallay-owned production semantics. Reusable canonical experience contracts belong in `src/core`; real target lowerers and adapters belong in their dedicated modules.
